defects.what: The stele fills the frame and is carved with two large columns of fake Chinese characters.
The stele the two workers are raising in the centre of the lens view is covered in fake Chinese characters.
The open notebook page in the centre is filled with lines of fake gold cursive.
Three book pages show huge brushed pseudo-numbers ("10", "20", a cut-off "1?") across the middle of the frame, and none of them is a date the script needs.
Indio's head and shoulders sit inside a black-bordered rectangular inset at upper right, a frame inside the frame.
A small temple building is pasted over the bridge of the nose, between the eyes of the large face behind the lamp.
The face inside the ring of hologram slots is a long-haired woman with no topknot and hooks on her cheeks, not Indio.
Indio has blue floral tattoo sleeves on both forearms in this pointing cutout.
The face in the centre of the hologram ring is a short-haired, girlish face with no topknot, which does not read as Indio.
The tomb's face stone has one large fake character at the top and small columns of fake characters below it.
Scribbled pseudo-text in the lower right of the notebook page under Indio's hand.
A small signature-like scrawl sits in the bottom-left corner.
A small watermark-like icon sits in the bottom-right corner.
Pseudo-lettering on the motorcycle tank badge and side cover, a fake plate on the blue car and a lettered sign outside the right window.
The green shop sign at the right edge and the stickers on the lamp post carry pseudo-text.
The labels on several bottles on the table at left carry small rows of pseudo-text.
